entity: Sabine Pass LNG terminal's greenhouse-gas rise, 2015-23
what_we_add: Rank 1 rise of 6,021 facilities (+6.08 Mt, next +2.90); seven LNG IDs 0.38 to 16.48 Mt while all direct emissions fell
why: EIP has Sabine Pass at 6.9M tons in 2023 (within 10% of our 6.26) and Verite/Grist says it quickly became one of Louisiana's largest sources. Nobody states the biggest-rise-in-the-registry rank.
